user.title: Connect to Lefant M1
user.description: Enter your Lefant M1 connection details. For a robot paired only with the Lefant app, Tuya IoT cloud APIs typically do not expose its Local Key. See the extraction guide referenced by this integration (hectorzin/Lefant-Home-Assistant-LocalTuya, app-traffic/MITM approach). Obtain the key separately on your own device; this integration does not extract it. Keep the key private.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the robot on TCP port 6668. Verify the IP address and make sure the robot is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Local Key. Encryption handshake failed.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred during connection test.

abort.already_configured: This Lefant M1 robot vacuum is already configured.
